annotations.title: Approve, deny, suspend, reinstate or remove a campaign creator

description: Decide on a creator in a campaign: approve or deny one waiting to join (joinApproval manual), suspend (their posts stop counting, a retainer pauses, and they are skipped by payouts) or reinstate one, remove one (earnings already approved stay theirs), or grant_retainer: pay a retainer month (period YYYY-MM) that had fewer approved posts than the minimum. read_creator_campaigns with campaignId shows the ids.
name: review_campaign_creator
title: Approve, deny, suspend, reinstate or remove a campaign creator
